evidence.snippet: JSON.stringify({ email, phone }), { service: privateKey(localId), accessible: Keychain.ACCESSIBLE.WHEN_UNLOCKED_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY, ... }
evidence.why: Email and phone (sensitive PII) are stored via react-native-keychain with device-only accessibility and biometric binding, not in cleartext storage.
Only non-sensitive opaque localId and displayName are written to the unencrypted SQLite database; no PII or secrets reach it.

controls_present: separation of sensitive vs non-sensitive data stores
